description.value: Omai Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Langley, BC, serving contemporary Japanese cuisine with an emphasis on fresh, high-quality ingredients in generous portions. It brands itself as the best-value sushi option in Langley and sits near the Langley ICBC Driver Licensing office on Willowbrook Drive. Online ordering and free delivery are available alongside dine-in service.
